## Duplication prevention

- [ ] Examined existing implementation and tests
- [ ] Examined open PRs/issues and competing branches
- [ ] No duplicated feature or incompatible parallel fix

## Engineering safeguards

- [ ] No unbounded RAM/CPU/queues/logs/model/session lifetimes
- [ ] Privacy/redaction/least-privilege and injection boundaries checked
- [ ] Destructive operations require explicit scope and verification
- [ ] Failure/retry/cancellation/recovery semantics reviewed
- [ ] Relevant documentation and user manual updated
